children: Silicon Valley Acquisition filed a Form S-4 to advance its proposed business combination with EigenQ and move toward a fourth-quarter 2026 close.
Filed registration statement on Form S-4 with SEC to support the proposed business combination with EigenQ.
Registration Statement includes a preliminary proxy statement/prospectus for shareholder vote and securities issuance.
Transaction contemplates SVAQ domesticating to Delaware and renaming to EigenQ Holdings upon closing.
PubCo common stock and public warrants have been applied to list on Nasdaq under proposed tickers EIGQ and EIGQW.
Closing remains subject to SEC effectiveness, shareholder approvals, listing requirements and customary conditions; expected Q4 2026.
